Why Sim2Me Is the Best eSIM for Greenland

TUSASS (formerly Tele Greenland) operates the country's sole mobile network, with 4G LTE in all major settlements and 3G along key routes. Sim2Me connects you to this network directly.

  • Average Speed: 20–50 Mbps in Nuuk; 10–30 Mbps in smaller settlements
  • Coverage: Nuuk, Ilulissat, Sisimiut, Qaqortoq – 4G. Ice sheet & remote areas – no signal
  • Standard: 4G LTE in towns; 3G between settlements

Simple Activation
